candidate_relations.reason: Muscle MRI and biceps-femoris biopsy show myositis/rhabdomyolysis, not metastatic deposits, so biliary cancer with muscle metastases conflicts with paraneoplastic myositis.
Jaundice and biliary obstruction are the hepatic presentation of extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, not the full cancer-plus-paraneoplastic-myositis object.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Liver/biliary obstruction is the hepatic presentation

case_quality_flags: Biliary-stricture biopsy is adenocarcinoma and muscle MRI shows myositis with rhabdomyolysis-range CK; muscle biopsy is myopathic, not metastatic
